equivalentQuery: SELECT p.ProductId, p.ProductName FROM dbo.Products AS p LEFT JOIN dbo.OrderLines AS line ON line.ProductId = p.ProductId WHERE line.OrderLineId IS NULL ORDER BY p.ProductId;
negativeQuery: SELECT p.ProductId, p.ProductName FROM dbo.Products AS p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.OrderLines AS line WHERE line.ProductId = p.ProductId) ORDER BY p.ProductId;
